title: Factory read-only review findings
description: Final answer of a read-only review run (clients.py run --read-only, used by factory review, fix and hotfix). The launcher validates it and renders it to a numbered Markdown list. API-safe structured-output subset: no length or count limits; the rendered report is truncated at 7900 bytes. No findings means no problems found.

summary.description: The overall result; with no findings, why there are none.

line.description: 1-based line; 0 when the problem has no single line.
